instruction: The precondition assembly file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file; it contains the starting assembly shown in the before image. Complete the assembly so it matches the target shape shown in the after image while using the correct physical joint behavior. Toggle Grounded for the orange part. Apply two Screw Joints for the bolts that thread into the orange base, one Screw Joint for the nut on the main bolt, three Revolute Joints for the yellow roller and the two spacer components on the main bolt, and one Revolute Joint for the pink frame to revolve around the orange base. Save the completed assembly to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
